map.养蜂采蜜量估算 使用指南: Beekeeping Honey Yield Estimator User Guide
map.输入蜂箱数量、花源面积与蜜源类型（油菜、椴树、荔枝等），估算年度可采蜜量并比较不: Enter the number of hives, the nectar area and the nectar source type (rapeseed, linden, lychee and so on) to estimate the annual harvestable honey and compare yield differences between nectar sources; used for apiary capacity planning and income estimation.
map.按蜂群数、蜜源种类、花源面积、气候与经验系数估算年度产蜜量，用于养蜂计划与收益测: Estimate the annual honey yield from the number of colonies, the type of nectar source, the nectar area, the climate and an experience coefficient; used for beekeeping planning and income estimation.
map.反推所需花源面积（每群约 4 亩），判断放蜂场地承载力是否匹配蜂群规模。: Work backwards to the nectar source area needed (about 4 mu per colony), to judge whether the carrying capacity of the apiary site matches the size of the colony.
map.按蜂蜜市价折算预估收入，比较不同蜜源品种的经济性。: Convert the result into estimated income at the market price of honey and compare the economics of different nectar sources.
map.：建议花源面积 = 蜂群数 × 4（亩）；面积系数：花源不足时 = 实际面积 ÷: : Recommended nectar area = number of colonies x 4 (mu); area coefficient: when nectar is insufficient it is the actual area divided by the recommended area (scaled proportionally), and it is 1.1 when the area exceeds three times the recommendation, otherwise 1.0; total honey (kg) = base yield of the nectar source x colonies x climate coefficient x experience coefficient x area coefficient; total jin = kg x 2; estimated income = kg x 40 CNY. Base yield (kg per colony): linden 60, longan 48, lychee 50, rapeseed 45, jujube 42, locust 40, sunflower 38, mixed nectar sources 35.
map.：椴树蜜源 20 群、花源 100 亩、气候 1.0、经验 1.0：建议面积 =: : Linden nectar, 20 colonies, nectar area 100 mu, climate 1.0, experience 1.0: recommended area = 20x4 = 80 mu, and since 100 mu does not exceed 240 mu the coefficient is 1.0; total honey = 60x20x1x1x1 = 1200 kg (2400 jin), income about 1200x40 = 48,000 CNY. If the nectar area is only 40 mu, the coefficient = 40/80 = 0.5 and the yield falls to 600 kg.
map.为什么要按每群 4 亩算花源？: Why is the nectar source calculated at 4 mu per colony?
map.蜂群采集半径内需要足够的蜜源植物支撑，花源不足时采集效率下降、产量按面积比例折减: Within the foraging radius of a colony there must be enough nectar plants to sustain it; when nectar is insufficient, foraging efficiency drops, yield is scaled down in proportion to the area, and supplementary feeding may even be needed.
map.气候与经验系数怎么取？: How are the climate and experience coefficients chosen?
map.气候按当年花期天气（干旱/多雨会显著降低泌蜜）取 0.6–1.2，经验按养蜂人管: Set the climate coefficient between 0.6 and 1.2 according to the weather during that year's flowering period (drought or heavy rain markedly reduces nectar secretion), and the experience coefficient between 0.7 and 1.2 according to the beekeeper's management level; if unsure, take 1.0 as the baseline and adjust to reality.
